cards.headline: PAP Senior’s Group pilots training for branch volunteers to identify and support isolated seniors
bullets: PAP volunteers will be trained to find and help lonely seniors in nine areas.
The new plan builds on existing house visits and Meet-the-People Sessions.
Volunteers will be taught how to befriend seniors and link them to help.
This aims to prevent isolated seniors from being overlooked.
A guide with local services and emergency contacts will also be shared.

cards.headline: Three taken to hospital after fire in Bukit Panjang HDB flat; 100 people evacuated
bullets: Three people were sent to hospital after a fire in a Bukit Panjang HDB flat.
About 100 residents were evacuated from the block as a safety measure.
The fire started in a bedroom and was put out by firefighters.
The blaze is thought to have been caused by an electrical issue.

cards.headline: How do I pick the right secondary school for my child?
bullets: Parents should consider a child's personality, not just grades, when picking a secondary school.
Consider schools where your child is likely to do well and feel confident.
Shortlist six to eight schools and balance ambitious choices with realistic ones.
Factor in travel time and school activities, as these are important for development.
About 6-7% of students in Integrated Programme schools leave early.

cards.headline: Bjorn Shen is a busy chef with 3 kids. Here’s his advice for working parents
bullets: Chef Bjorn Shen has three children aged one to nine.
He reads a picture book written by his wife to his kids.
Shen started his restaurant Artichoke in 2010.
He was a judge on MasterChef Singapore for four seasons.

cards.headline: How fatherhood changes brain biology and body shape
bullets: New dads' brains show less grey matter after their babies are born.
This change happens within the first year of fatherhood.
Brain matter can change throughout life with new experiences.

cards.headline: Four master tenants at Punggol East, Tebing Lane offered lease extension of up to a year
bullets: Four master tenants at Punggol East and Tebing Lane can get lease extensions up to one year.
This allows businesses to stay until the end of 2027.
The extension helps businesses prepare for moving out.
Agencies will help find new places for affected businesses.

cards.headline: There's a magic school at Orchard Towers and I tried being a magician for an hour – here's how it went
bullets: A new magic school and theatre called Institute Illusions has opened at Orchard Towers.
The school offers one-hour magic lessons for children aged six to twelve.
Lessons allow kids to learn two magic skills, with over 15 skills available.
The founder, award-winning magician Tommillusions, teaches the lessons.
Trying magic yourself is fun, even if you don't become a professional.

cards.headline: Meet a 25-year-old third-generation zookeeper whose family has worked at the zoo since it opened 53 years ago
bullets: A 25-year-old is now a third-generation zookeeper at River Wonders.
Her grandfather started at Singapore Zoo when it opened in 1973.
Her father joined Night Safari in 1994.
She cares for over 200 animals at her job.

cards.headline: Air quality back to moderate across Singapore after central region hits unhealthy range
bullets: Air quality improved to moderate after the central region hit unhealthy levels.
Smoke plumes from Sumatra and Kalimantan caused the haze.
Dry weather is expected to continue, with a risk of haze.
Authorities advised vulnerable groups to reduce outdoor activity if air quality worsens.

cards.headline: AI startup Suno’s new tool puts music to spoken word
bullets: AI music startup Suno launched a new tool to add background music to spoken words like poems.
The tool, called “Speech”, complements Suno’s main service of creating songs from text.
Suno is valued at over US$5 billion and has over two million paying users.
Suno is facing lawsuits from music labels over using copyrighted songs for training its AI.
Warner Music settled with Suno and signed a licensing deal, but others are still in court.

cards.headline: Authorities seize $39 million from sale of building linked to scam probe
bullets: Authorities seized $39 million from the sale of a building linked to a scam probe.
The commercial building in Bukit Merah was sold for $39 million to an automotive firm.
The building was previously linked to Cambodia's Prince Group, accused of fraud.
Police are investigating individuals and firms connected to Prince Group's chairman.

cards.headline: 2026 Lexus RZ 350e review: This pure electric SUV has surprising rivals
bullets: The new Lexus RZ 350e electric SUV has a single motor and a longer range of 509 km.
It offers a good driving feel with precise steering, unlike many other electric cars.
The car's interior is spacious, but lacks storage and has some surprisingly cheap-feeling parts.
Cheaper electric SUVs like the Toyota bZ4X and Subaru e-Outback offer similar driving fun.
The Lexus RZ 350e costs S$357,800 with COE and is available now.

cards.headline: Range Rover Sport Electric review: Uncovering the plane truth behind the marque’s sporty new EV
bullets: The new electric Range Rover Sport has 550 horsepower and can go from 0 to 100 kmh in 4.5 seconds.
Engineers tested the electric Range Rover Sport in extreme heat, freezing cold, and even drove it through an aeroplane.
The electric Range Rover Sport looks very similar to the petrol version, with only minor design changes.
It has a large 118.5 kWh battery, and can gain about 218 km of range in just 10 minutes of charging.
The car is designed to handle well on roads and off-road, with features like all-wheel steering.

cards.headline: Range Rover’s boss says the brand has one thing no one can copy
bullets: Range Rover's boss says their British heritage is something rivals cannot copy.
The company leads in technology like its fast all-terrain response system.
Range Rover's new electric models offer flexible power options for customers.
They focus on refinement and capability, not just flashy tech specs.

cards.headline: 'He's mature, I'm childish': HK actress, 38, goes public with boyfriend, 22, playfully addresses age gap
bullets: Actress Snowy Bai, 38, confirmed her relationship with her 22-year-old boyfriend on Instagram.
She shared photos of them together in an October 2026 post.
Bai, born in 1988, and her boyfriend, born in 2004, have a 16-year age difference.
She playfully noted their age gap, saying 'He's mature, and I'm childish.'
The couple faced challenges due to distance and language barriers but share similar interests.

cards.headline: Former Wah!Banana actor reflects on 3 years in jail, acquittal of rape charges & future plans
bullets: Former Wah!Banana actor Lev Panfilov was cleared of rape charges on appeal in September 2026.
He spent over three years in jail after being convicted in May 2025.
Panfilov described his ordeal as a life-changing experience, learning to live in prison.
His legal fees for the case amounted to nearly S$500,000.

cards.headline: Containers bought outside S'pore not eligible for deposit refund under BCRS, even with label
bullets: Drinks bought outside Singapore won't get deposit refunds under the new scheme.
From Oct 1, 2026, all cans and plastic bottles sold must have a 10-cent deposit mark.
Even if containers from overseas have the wrong label, they won't be refunded.
The scheme only applies to drinks sold here, with refunds via special machines.

cards.headline: LEGO F1 Experience The Thrill At Suntec City: Life-Sized LEGO F1 Car & Game Booths With Freebies
bullets: A life-sized LEGO F1 car is at Suntec City for the race season.
You can play games and win freebies there.
It's part of the Formula 1 celebrations happening now.

cards.headline: 12 Singapore IC & Passport Facts You Probably Didn’t Know, Like What The S & T On Your IC Mean
bullets: The 'S' on your Singapore IC does not stand for Singapore.
The 'T' on your Singapore IC also has a specific meaning.
Your NRIC number has a checksum digit that can be a letter or a number.
The colour of your passport might indicate its type and validity period.

bullets: Get up to $35 off home upgrades when you use DBS/POSB Instalment Payment Plan.
